test_coverage_notes: AMMDeposit validation is typically covered in unit/integration tests under the transaction processing suite. Look for files like 'AMMDeposit_test.cpp', 'AMM_test.cpp', or 'Transactor_test.cpp' in the rippled or xrpl repo. These should test flag combinations, malformed transactions, and edge cases (e.g., missing/extra fields, invalid asset pairs, negative/zero amounts). Gaps may exist for rare flag combinations, feature toggles (e.g., MPTokens), or error propagation paths. Ensure tests cover all branches in the flag validation logic and all error returns in preflight.

validation_architecture.framework: Custom validation in business logic (no external framework)
